purpose: Shared component pins and truthful readiness status for Founder-OS, CORE, PUBLIC, and PusingCuk.

authority_model.Founder-OS: Durable decisions, constraints, recovery context, curated knowledge index.
authority_model.kawasan-masjid-core: Runtime truth, authorization, operational data, AI orchestration, and evidence.
authority_model.kawasan-masjid-public: Public-safe web experience; never a second backend or private knowledge store.
authority_model.pusingcuk: Canonical language, specification, interpreter/native runtime, registered .cuk rules, and conformance.

capabilities.native_rule: One deterministic registered .cuk rule; exact source hash and runtime commit are pinned.
capabilities.founder_knowledge: Bounded lexical ranking over a curated public-safe index; source links and index commit returned.
capabilities.local_llm: Ollama provider source; default model qwen3:4b; no hosted LLM API key required for local inference.
capabilities.runner_boundary: Authenticated local prototype; allowlist, strict input schema, timeout, output bound and capability denial.
capabilities.model_training: Not implemented; PusingCuk is a language/runtime, not a trained LLM.
capabilities.production_runner: Not deployed; local runner is not an OS sandbox and must not be internet-exposed.
capabilities.repository_freeze: Not approved until migration parity, auth/data/audit preservation, backups, restore and rollback are verified.

verification_status.last_known_green_core_run_scope: Earlier CI proof on a static-input native .cuk rule and Core Quality Gate; it does not verify the newest local runner/retrieval commits.
verification_status.current_main_push_runs: Not independently confirmed in this session. Do not treat the newly-added runner/service tests as green until GitHub Actions reports success.
verification_status.production_deployments: No Supabase production deployment or database migration was performed by this integration work.

freeze_gates: All required CORE operations are replaced and behavior/security parity tests pass.
Founder-OS decision history and recovery context are preserved with provenance.
All callers, Edge Functions, workflows, schedules and public contracts are inventoried.
Backup/restore, rollback and security review have been rehearsed and explicitly accepted by the Founder.
